blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A French emergency response team has donated two tactical drones and conducted firefighting and emergency response training for responders in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, to strengthen the municipality’s preparedness for forest fires and other disasters. The Pompiers de l’Urgence Internationale (PUI), or International Emergency Firefighters, led by its founder and president, Philippe Besson, arrived in Guiuan on Friday, Oct. 30, to turn over the equipment and share their expertise with members of the Community Fire Auxiliary Groups and other local emergency personnel. The training activities were conducted in coordination with the municipal government, the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and […]...
